properties.description: Writes classified branch-scoped by dec:which-design-records-belong-to-a-branch, from a session on a non-default branch, land in that branch's overlay, not the shared store. Reads from that session see shared ∪ overlay. Exporting that session's worktree writes shared ∪ overlay into the worktree's saved design, so the branch's committed design carries exactly its own facts and none of a sibling's. Intent writes from the same session still go live. Designed 2026-09-23 (dec:how-a-branchs-implementation-facts-are-held).
properties.name: A branch's implementation facts are held in its own overlay, never in main's
